title: Ginkgo — right-edge website scene
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: full-width website scene background, landscape 16:9.
Primary request: Oversized ginkgo fan leaves and slender branching stems sweep into the frame from the RIGHT EDGE and TOP RIGHT. The artwork is deliberately cropped at those edges, suggesting a larger botanical environment extending beyond the image.
Scene/backdrop: Neutral almost-white paper, color #F7F8F4. The LEFT 60 percent of the entire canvas must be completely clean, flat and uniformly almost-white #F7F8F4, reserved for actual HTML text. The BOTTOM 12 percent across the whole width must also be completely clean, flat and uniformly the same almost-white paper. No marks, leaves, texture, shadows, tint or decoration in either reserved region.
Subject/composition: Confine ALL illustrated leaves, branches and marks to the RIGHTMOST 38 percent and ABOVE the bottom 12 percent. Large elegantly overlapping fan-shaped ginkgo leaves, deliberate edge crops at top and right, rich angular and scalloped leaf silhouettes; a clearly asymmetrical large environment, not a centered or floating botanical bouquet.
Style/medium: Restrained editorial botanical art in sage, celadon and cream. Strongly visible fine ASCII and terminal glyph stippling: tiny crisp monospace punctuation and letter-like glyphs build the leaf shapes, contours and radiating veins. No readable words. Detailed pointillist terminal-art texture in leaves, crisp silhouettes, calm muted values with a few dusty teal accents. The motif joins the empty paper naturally through sparse individual marks near leaf edges, not a generic white fade.
Constraints: Keep the center-left genuinely empty and perfectly flat nearly white. No all-over green tint or paper texture. No isolated botanical sticker, oval, bounding frame, border, vignette, blur, gradient fade, cast shadow, UI, text, logo or watermark. Maintain clean bottom strip. Only right-edge/top-right artwork, with 60 percent blank left canvas.
inspection: Strong visible glyph-based leaf texture and crisp right/top edge cropping. Almost-white left field and bottom margin. Largest leaf/sparse marks reach roughly 54% across canvas, so requested 60% left clearance is short by about 6 percentage points; center-left remains empty.
